convert_axis_angle_to_rotation_matrix: convert a batch of axis-angle vectors to 3x3 rotation matrices using the Rodrigues formula
convert_quaternion_to_rotation_matrix: convert a batch of quaternion coefficients to 3x3 rotation matrices
convert_6d_to_rotation_matrix: convert a batch of 6D rotation representations to 3x3 rotation matrices using Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization
compute_perspective_projection: compute the perspective projection of 3D points given camera rotation, translation, focal length, and camera center
estimate_camera_translation: estimate camera translation that brings 3D joints closest to corresponding 2D joint observations
